task: #345 — re-host Dropbox masters into object storage
notes: Ran the script in chunks (long-running, exceeded a single tool-call timeout); the script is idempotent — it only scans rows whose audio_url still starts with http(s)://, so each chunk picked up where the last one left off. The chunked nature is why earlier per-chunk summary files reported small `scanned` numbers; this rolled-up summary reflects the full task.
Re-running the script after this is a no-op: SELECT count(*) FROM songs WHERE audio_url LIKE 'http%' returns 0.

audio_container_ext was originally written as `.download` (the tempfile suffix) due to a probe bug; that bug was fixed in the script AND remediated in prod via UPDATE songs SET audio_container_ext = lower(substring(audio_url FROM '\.([A-Za-z0-9]+)$')) — values now match the actual file extension (.wav/.mp3/.flac/.m4a).

verification.stillOffBucketQuery: SELECT count(*) FROM songs WHERE audio_url LIKE 'http%'
verification.missingSpecsQuery: SELECT count(*) FROM songs WHERE audio_url LIKE '/objects/%' AND (audio_format IS NULL OR audio_sample_rate IS NULL OR audio_bytes IS NULL)
